task.name: calmod
task.shortdescription: Rotate a Measurement Set to a new phase-center
task.description: This application retrieves calibrator information via telescope-specific web services and writes this information as a componentlist so that it may be used by applications downstream.

param.name: outfile
param.shortdescription: The name of the output component list to be written. Must be specified
param.description: The name of the output component list to be written. Must be specified Default: none, must be specified Example: outfile='3c273.cl'

param.name: source
param.description: The calibrator name. The case-insensitive names ‘3C48’, ‘3C286’, ‘3C138’, and ‘3C147’ are supported. Exactly one of source or direction must be specified.

param.name: direction
param.description: An alternative to source. It is the direction of the calibrator. The supported formats are those of CASA’s direction measure formats, eg 'J2000 12:34:56 -12.34.56'. The web service will attempt to locate a known calibrator near this direction. Exactly one of source or direction must be specified.

param.name: band
param.shortdescription: The receiver band for which the source structure is needed
param.description: A string representing the case-insensitive code of the band for which the data are required. For the VLA, supported codes are ‘P’, ‘L’, ‘S’, ‘C’, ‘X’, ‘U’, ‘K’, ‘A’ and ‘Q’.

param.name: obsdate
param.description: The date for which to obtain the calibrator information, in MJD. Non-positive values will cause an exception to be thrown.

param.name: refdate
param.shortdescription: The reference date in MJD after which new database entries will be ignored.
param.description: The reference date in MJD after which new database entries will be ignored. Used to support historical reproducibility. A non-positive value will result in this parameter being ignored, and the most recent entry will be used (which may be later than obsdate).

param.name: hosts
param.shortdescription: List of hostnames to use when querying the web service.
param.description: List of hostnames to use when querying the web service. They will be queried in order until a successful response is received.
